The named regression passes on f1f1bd450 in the 17-test inventory reconciliation run. This closes J5's specific test failure, not the broader live desktop acceptance battery.
H3 and K1 report the same standing-context expansion mechanism at different measurements. Preserve both observations and require a current complete-answer replay without degrading context use.
K1 explicitly identifies itself as H3's still-standing measurement. It is a second original obligation link in the same mechanism, not a second independent implementation task.

All five tests pass on f1f1bd450, including the generated-family measurement. Commit 4a9bf7ece implements a head-versus-leaf control, not literal inline expansion where that is unrepresentable. The original broader control remains evidence_needed until its acceptance scope is adjudicated; this does not close independent broad transfer or all control arms.
Keep inspection, construction, evaluation, installation, persistence and reuse as separate acceptance conditions within the shared mechanism. Checked neighboring inline items are not reopened.
Compare the later failure-signature work with every named original requirement; a second concept alone does not prove all failure classes.
